patch_description: This version concentrates computation on the strongest known geometric basin: staggered hexagonal layers with poles, plus cube-axis and random alternatives. It uses pair-indexed soft-extrema gradients for lower allocation overhead, preserves the true squared evaluator objective throughout, and adds deterministic perturb-and-refine restarts around the best first-stage candidate. These controlled symmetry-breaking restarts are useful because the best 14-point configurations are slightly nonsymmetric, while a final high-sharpness polish improves the active contact graph.
